description: This Java source file defines the class InlineRequestHelper which provides utility methods to handle inline suggestion requests, create inline presentations, datasets, and slices for autofill inline suggestions in an Android environment.

classes.name: InlineRequestHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to support inline suggestion requests, create inline suggestions, datasets, and slices, facilitating inline autofill in Android.

methods.name: getInlineSuggestionsRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the InlineSuggestionsRequest from a FillRequest if present and valid.

methods.name: getMaxSuggestionCount
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of suggestions to show, constrained by the inline request.

methods.name: maybeCreateInlineAuthenticationResponse
methods.description: Creates an InlinePresentation for authentication purposes if an inline suggestions request is present.

methods.name: createInlineDataset
methods.description: Creates an InlinePresentation dataset for autofill suggestions with specified value and index.

methods.name: createInlineActionDataset
methods.description: Builds a Dataset with inline presentations and associated actions, including an intent to launch a settings activity.
